headline: Certificate of Compliance issued for completed city drainage project at 35 Harmony Lane (MCC File 01-021)
summary: The Conservation Commission reviewed a request for a Certificate of Compliance for the completed city drainage project at 35 Harmony Lane, part of the Bare Meadow Project, originally permitted around 2001. After discussing an inspection memo from Felix Garcia, Jr., the Commission voted unanimously to issue the certificate.
decisions: Approved issuing the Certificate of Compliance for MCC File 01-021 at 35 Harmony Lane, unanimously.

plain_text:
Minutes of a Special Public Meeting – August 14, 2026 
The City of Methuen Conservation Commission held a special public meeting via 
Zoom video conferencing (VC) on August 14, 2026, at 12:02 p.m.  Present for this 
meeting were Dave Di Zazzo, Chair; Kenneth Sateriale, Secretary; Rachel Lecher, 
Commissioner; Patrice Friant, Commissioner; and Chris Parsons, Conservation 
Officer.  Also present were Haleigh Reisman, Conservation Staff Attorney; 
Michelle Davidson, Conservation Clerk; and Jennifer Buco, Property Owner 
Representative.  Commissioners Cara Seaman and Sandra Bouley were absent. 
Chairman Dave Di Zazzo announced that, pursuant to Chapter 20 of the Acts of 
2021, this meeting was conducted via remote means in accordance with applicable 
law.  Members of the public body, as well as members of the public, were able to 
access the meeting via virtual means through Zoom video conferencing.  In the 
event that access and participation were not achieved, the Commission would post 
on the City of Methuen website an audio or video recording, transcript, or other 
comprehensive record of proceedings as soon as possible after the meeting. 
 
 
CALL TO ORDER: 8:02 a.m. 
 
NEW BUSINESS: 
Request for Certificate of Compliance – DEP File #219-021, MCC File #01-
021 – 35 Harmony Lane – Bare Meadow Project – City Drainage Project. 
 
Registered Order of Conditions: Book Number 6115, Page 171 
The Commission reviewed the request for a Certificate of Compliance for the 
completed city drainage project at 35 Harmony Lane, associated with the Bare 
Meadow Project.  The project was originally permitted approximately 25 years ago 
(circa 2001).
Page 2 
Commissioner Ken Sateriale raised questions regarding a memo from Felix Garcia, 
Jr., Professional Engineer, and Deputy Director of the Department of Public 
Works.  The memo noted that the review was based on a visual inspection from the 
street and a review of city records, rather than a new field survey or as-built plan.  
Mr. Garcia's memo indicated he would be willing to arrange for additional 
documentation if required by Commission practice. 
Commissioner Sateriale asked Conservation Officer Chris Parsons to confirm 
whether a visual inspection was adequate for a project of this age.  Mr. Parsons 
confirmed that the visual inspection was sufficient, noting via chat that the project 
is over 20 years old and has had no problems. 
 
MOTION: Motion made by Sateriale to issue the Certificate of Compliance for 
MCC File 01-021, 35 Harmony Lane.  Seconded by Friant.  All in favor.  Vote: 
Unanimous. 
Document Signing 
Following the vote, Haleigh Reisman distributed the Certificate of Compliance via 
DocuSign for electronic signatures.  Commissioners successfully signed the 
document electronically after the vote was taken.  
 
ADJOURNMENT: 8:10 p.m. 
There being no further business, a motion to adjourn was made by Sateriale and 
seconded by Friant.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous. 
Respectfully submitted by, 
Dave Di Zazzo, Chair
